headline: 355 COMANCHE'S PRICE CAME DOWN TODAY AND A NEW SHOWING BOOKED FOR THURSDAY WITHIN HOURS OF IT — the first fresh booking that listing has taken since three separate buyers told you it was too high; meanwhile 2368 Ridge Trail returned its first read since the contract died and it is a price objection with a staging score of 2, the lowest that house has ever recorded.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 A WRITTEN OFFER IS IN — the strongest thing this board has ever recorded, on a listing that went 75 days without one. You sent both sellers the full package at 5:38 this morning: the terms, what the buyers want to keep, both net sheets and a recommended counter. ⚠️ TWELVE HOURS LATER YOUR OWN SELLERS HAVE NOT REPLIED, which means the counter never reached the buyer's side today at all.
hotSignals.action: Call them tonight rather than emailing again — a two-seller decision on a first offer after 75 days stalls out of uncertainty, not disagreement, and a five-minute call usually unsticks it. ⭐ THE LEVERAGE IS ON THIS BOARD AND IT IS EVIDENCE, NOT OPINION: two independent agents toured this house across 75 days and NEITHER ONE TOUCHED THE PRICE QUESTION — every price and price-recommendation field on both forms came back blank. The stated objections were the upstairs bathroom and a compartmentalized interior. If the offer is light, that is the argument.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE NUMBER MOVED AND THE MARKET ANSWERED THE SAME AFTERNOON. The MLS line on this listing read $299,000 in last night's seller report; today's 1:50 PM showing notice reads $295,000 · ACTIVE against the same MLS ID — and that notice IS a new booking, Thursday 8/6 at 11:00 AM, the first fresh appointment this listing has taken since the cut appeared. ⭐ It follows Angela B. of Keller Williams Realty Vestavia filing interested YES with 'too high' attached in the same form on 8/2, staged 4 of 5 — the highest score this listing has recorded — and naming a competing house her client is weighing it against.
hotSignals.action: Two moves, both small. ⭐ FIRST, GO BACK TO ANGELA B. NOW THAT THERE IS A NUMBER TO GO BACK WITH — your outreach to her went out 8/3 in your own voice and is still unanswered; a price change is the one legitimate reason to re-open that thread, and her client is actively choosing between this house and one other. ⭐ SECOND, CONFIRM THE FIGURE ON THE MLS — this is one system receipt showing a field that changed between two machine reads twenty hours apart, and no other routine in the fleet has recorded the change. ⛔ NOBODY HAS EVER NAMED A REPLACEMENT NUMBER on this listing — every price-recommendation field on all three reads came back blank, so do not let a number be inferred from the board.

hotSignals.signal: Mallory W. of ARC Realty Vestavia filed interested YES · priced JUST RIGHT · "Client loves the space and the fact that it has room for washer and dryer" — and phoned three minutes earlier to say her client "really, really liked it" and "wants to put an offer in" but needs to save a little more for the down payment, asking to be kept in the loop if any other offer arrives. ⭐ People who ask to be warned about competition are planning to compete.
hotSignals.action: Call her back with the three questions that decide it: how far out is she really, has she actually spoken to a lender, and would seller-paid closing costs or a longer close bridge the gap. ⛔ DO NOT READ THIS AS A PRICE SIGNAL — she wrote JUST RIGHT. The blocker is financing timing, which is solvable. ⚠️ THE FOLLOW-UP HAS BEEN A STAGED, UNSENT DRAFT SINCE 5:51 YESTERDAY MORNING — thirty-six hours of a machine holding open a conversation the phone would close.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE BUYER SIDE CALLED TO ASK ABOUT COMPETING OFFERS. An assistant to the agent who showed it Monday evening texted at 8:30 that night asking whether there are any offers in or expected. ⭐ Agents do not ask that about houses their buyers are lukewarm on. ⭐ And the sellers' own doorbell camera is the corroboration: Dennis wrote at 8:48 that night — "the mom said she loved it multiple times, talked about how much they liked the grass."
hotSignals.action: Answer the competing-offer question honestly, in either direction, today — it is the move that either produces paper or clears the deck, and it has been open more than 24 hours. ⚠️ NO WRITTEN READ HAS RETURNED FROM MONDAY'S 6:15 TOUR OR FROM TODAY'S 11:00, so the doorbell camera and that text are the only evidence you have — treat them as real signal but not as a filed opinion. ⭐ Six tours in seven days across five brokerages on a house that took one showing in its first eleven days; the owner-occupants have cleared out three times in 24 hours and deserve to hear the pattern.

upcoming: 📅 TOMORROW — Wed 8/5 — 195 LAKE VIEW CIRCLE, Riverside. HOME INSPECTION. ⭐ Close date receipted 8/31; the contract-to-close packet went out Monday 12:09 and title confirmed receipt at 12:57. ✅ Nothing is owed by your side. Two pieces of paperwork landed this afternoon and neither touches your sellers' net — the dotloop addendum is an ADDRESS CORRECTION (the title file has been running "Lake View Dr" against a Cir property) and the client-care fee disclosed at 3:42 is payable by the BUYER.

📅 THURSDAY — Thu 8/6 11:00 AM — 355 COMANCHE STREET, Montevallo. 🔥 THE FIRST BOOKING THIS LISTING HAS TAKEN SINCE THE PRICE CAME DOWN, confirmed at 1:50 this afternoon on the same notice that carried the new number. $295,000 · ACTIVE re-verified on the notice.

⚠️ THAT IS THE ENTIRE FORWARD CALENDAR — two appointments, and only one of them is a buyer. Every other confirmed showing in the fourteen-day window has already run. ⭐ WHICH MEANS THE THREE LISTINGS CARRYING LIVE INTEREST — Altamont, Comanche and Rena — all need a phone call rather than a booking. Nothing on this board converts itself between now and Thursday morning.
